instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and both arms bent at your sides.
2. Lift your right knee toward your chest and twist your torso right, bringing your left elbow to the knee.
3. Tap the elbow to the knee twice.
4. Lower the leg and return your torso to face forward.
5. Repeat on the left side, alternating.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and avoid leaning too far forward.
2. Rotate from the torso, not just the shoulders.
3. Brace your core to stay balanced on one leg.
4. Exhale as the elbow meets the knee.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your fists near your sides.
2. Punch both arms forward while lifting your right knee to about waist height.
3. Return your arms and leg to the start.
4. Punch both arms forward again while lifting your left knee.
5. Continue alternating legs with each set of punches.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive the punches from your shoulders and finish with the triceps.
2. Brace your core to stay balanced as you lift each leg.
3. Keep your chest tall and avoid leaning back.
4. Exhale as you punch and lift.

instructions:
1. Start on all fours, then lift your hips to form an inverted V with straight arms and legs.
2. Keep your hands flat and your head between your arms.
3. Drive one heel down toward the floor while the other lifts.
4. Switch feet quickly in a running motion.
5. Keep alternating at a steady pace.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight and press the floor away through your hands.
2. Brace your core to stop your hips from sagging.
3. Keep a steady rhythm as you switch feet.
4. Breathe evenly throughout.

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
2. Let your arms hang at your sides.
3. Drag the dumbbells up along your torso by pulling your elbows back.
4. Lift until the dumbbells reach chest height and squeeze your biceps.
5. Lower the dumbbells slowly along your torso.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the dumbbells close to your body the whole time.
2. Pull your elbows back rather than forward.
3. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold a handle in each hand, palms facing forward, arms extended down.
3. Keep your back straight and your chest up.
4. Drag the handles up along your torso by pulling your elbows back.
5. Lift until your hands reach chest level, then lower slowly.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the handles close to your torso throughout.
2. Pull your elbows straight back, not out to the sides.
3. Use a band tension that lets you keep control.
4. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
